test_title: PYST 37: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 14 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Six people, A, B, C, D, E and F, are sitting in a row, facing north. Only two people sit to the left of F. Only one person sits between D and E. F sits to the immediate left of D. A sits to the immediate right of C. B sits third to the right of A. Who sits at the extreme left end of the line?
solution:
**Given: **Six people, A, B, C, D, E and F, are sitting in a row, facing north.

1. Only two people sit to the left of F.

2. Only one person sits between D and E.

3. F sits to the immediate left of D.

4. A sits to the immediate right of C.

5. B sits third to the right of A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/240940ac59f5a123ea1381803112e92b337f2f26ba86dc82a6fa3f8fe46aca7a.png] 

Thus, C sits at the extreme left end of the line.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
